instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME & CSS TOKENS: Keep the dark tactical operations command-center feel. Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with @import "@fontsource-variable/outfit"; @import "@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans"; @import "@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono"; and configure --font-heading: 'Outfit Variable', sans-serif; --font-sans: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; --font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;

2. SEED DATA & REAL METRICS: The backend seed should generate the full synthetic Instamart ecosystem: 1,200 customers, 12,300 orders, 164 tickets, 5 policy docs (Instant Refund, Missing Items, Delayed Delivery, Quality Complaints, Abuse Prevention), 7 SQL analyses results, K-means profiles (4 clusters: Power Grocery, Weekend Snacker, Occasional Top-up, Lapsed Bargain), Lapse prediction model (AUC, Precision, Recall, F1), Zero-shot vs Few-shot triage comparison stats, and 7 benchmark refund scenarios.

3. PIPELINE PART A (Data Quality): Display raw audit stats (missing fields, duplicate checks), cleaning transformations executed with row change counts, and 7 interactive SQL analytical queries (e.g., GMV by slot, peak complaint items, darkstore SLA breach, item returns rate) with tabular view + export/copy SQL feature.

4. PIPELINE PART B (Segments & Retention): Render interactive cluster metrics, PCA scatter chart with cluster coloring, model evaluation metrics card (Lapse model: ROC-AUC ~0.84, Precision/Recall tradeoff curve), and a filterable 'High-Risk Premium Retention' table with quick-action engagement suggestions.

5. PIPELINE PART C (Triage Console): Render privacy redaction proof diff pane (Raw ticket vs Redacted ticket side-by-side highlighting masked PII), Zero-shot vs Few-shot accuracy chart and token budget tracker ($/ticket & latency ms), and full 164-row interactive ticket table with filters for Security Team, Premium Desk, Support Queue, and Human Review with quick routing reassignment.

6. PIPELINE PART D (Policy Q&A & Refund Agent Runner): Build the Policy Q&A with retrieval grounding (showing document citation tags, policy clause snippet, confidence score, and sample questions). Build the live Refund Agent Runner with step-by-step tool execution timeline: Step 1: Parse Ticket -> Step 2: Fetch Order History -> Step 3: Check Customer Lifetime Value & Abuse Score -> Step 4: Evaluate Policy Rules -> Step 5: Execute Decision (Approve / Reject / Partial / Human Escalate) with INR calculation. Include the 7 benchmark scenarios with instant 1-click execution and playback.

7. TEST ATTRIBUTES: Ensure all buttons, search bars, tabs, scenario triggers, filters, and modal triggers have descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='tab-data-quality', data-testid='run-scenario-btn-1', data-testid='ticket-filter-status', data-testid='policy-question-input', data-testid='policy-ask-submit-btn').
8. ERROR HANDLING & STATIC FALLBACK: Follow template guidelines — ensure frontend functions gracefully with rich mock data fallbacks if backend requests fail, preventing blank error screens.

accessibility.wcag_level: WCAG AA compliant (4.5:1 minimum contrast for all text against dark surfaces)
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab and arrow key support for tabs, table pagination, agent timeline stepper, and policy search
accessibility.screen_readers: Descriptive ARIA labels on all metric scorecards, badge states, and tool-invocation status icons

motion.timeline_steps: Staggered fade-and-slide for autonomous agent tool invocations
